summary: Russia launched a large-scale missile and drone barrage targeting Odesa region ports and critical infrastructure across Ukraine, while Ukrainian strikes hit a Russian port in Rostov region. Russian tactical aviation conducted guided bomb strikes on Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions, and Crimea faces seventh day of blackouts.
key_points: Russia threatened 4-8 missile strikes on Odesa region ports Chornomorsk and Pivdenne with Su-30, Su-34, Su-35, Su-57/34 and Orion UAV detected over Black and Azov seas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68895)
First cruise missile reported heading toward Odesa amid active air defense operations (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68899)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Synelnykove district Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions (Source: @kpszsu/68263, @kpszsu/68266)
Russian drone operators disrupted AFU ammunition delivery in Druzhkivka and thwarted attack near Krasnohorivka (Source: @tass_agency/384974, @tass_agency/384969)
Ukraine struck Azov Sea port in Rostov region with FP-1 drone days ago (Source: @eRadarrua/100724)
Russia attacked critical infrastructure in Chernihiv cutting power to 61k+ subscribers (Source: @eRadarrua/100717)
Dzhankoi Crimea remains without electricity for seventh day causing water supply crisis (Source: @UkraineNow/82604)
Poland transferred 5 Patriot missiles to Ukraine; Germany to finance 50k Shrike FPV drones (Source: @UkraineNow/82602, @ukr_leaks_eng/31567)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a coordinated missile and drone offensive targeting Odesa region ports with up to 8 missiles threatened, supported by Su-30, Su-34, Su-35, Su-57/34 aircraft and Orion UAV over Black and Azov seas. Russian tactical aviation struck Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia with guided bombs while drone operators disrupted Ukrainian logistics in Druzhkivka and repelled an attack near Krasnohorivka. Ukraine retaliated with a drone strike on Rostov region's Azov Sea port and received 5 Patriot missiles from Poland as Germany commits to 50,000 FPV drones.

points: Ukraine struck the Azov Sea port in Rostov region with an FP-1 drone several days ago, demonstrating deep-strike capability against Russian logistics hubs (Source: @eRadarrua/100724).

Poland transferred 5 Patriot missiles to Ukraine following requests from NATO Secretary General Rutte and US European Command General Grinkevich, with Poland to receive 50 replacement missiles from NATO/US if threatened (Source: @UkraineNow/82602).

Germany will finance the purchase of 50,000 Shrike FPV attack drones manufactured by Ukrainian firm SkyFall with Auterion autonomous targeting software, one of the largest Western drone procurements for Kyiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31567).
A possible Ukrainian strike targeted Moscow region with a message "Mrazoty, this is for Vyshneve. Moscow region" appearing after explosions in Vyshneve near Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68914).

Ukrainian air defenses engaged multiple Russian cruise missiles and Shahed-type UAVs across Odesa, Cherkasy, Poltava, Kirovohrad, and Sumy regions throughout the reporting period (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68899, @mon1tor_ua/68912, @mon1tor_ua/68910, @mon1tor_ua/68892, @eRadarrua/100722).

Russian forces threatened 4-8 missile strikes on Odesa region within 20-30 minutes targeting Chornomorsk port, Odesa, and Pivdenne port, with Su-30, Orion UAV over Black Sea, Su-34 over Crimea, and Su-34, Su-57/34, Su-35 over Azov Sea detected (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68895).
First cruise missile launched toward Odesa confirmed; Su-34 over Azov Sea heading to Crimea with Kh-59 missile threat (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68899, @mon1tor_ua/68894).
Russian tactical aviation conducted guided aerial bomb strikes on Synelnykove district Dnipropetrovsk region and Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @kpszsu/68263, @kpszsu/68266).

Russian drone operators disrupted AFU ammunition delivery in Druzhkivka (Donetsk region) and thwarted Ukrainian attack attempt on positions near Krasnohorivka (Source: @tass_agency/384974, @tass_agency/384969).
Russia attacked critical infrastructure in Chernihiv cutting electricity to over 61,000 subscribers (Source: @eRadarrua/100717).
Russian air defenses destroyed 8 drones approaching Moscow per Moscow Mayor Sobyanin (Source: @tass_agency/384943).

Dzhankoi and surrounding Crimea districts remain without electricity for seventh consecutive day, causing severe water shortages due to fuel deficits for pumping stations (Source: @UkraineNow/82604, @UkraineNow/82592).
Russian drone operators disrupted Ukrainian ammunition delivery to positions in Druzhkivka, Donetsk region (Source: @tass_agency/384974).
Russian drone operators thwarted Ukrainian attack attempt on positions near Krasnohorivka (referred to as Krasnogo Limana), Donetsk region (Source: @tass_agency/384969).
Russian tactical aviation struck Synelnykove district Dnipropetrovsk region with guided aerial bombs, indicating continued pressure on eastern approaches (Source: @kpszsu/68263).

Multiple jet UAVs (Shahed-type) launched from Dnipropetrovsk region toward Kirovohrad region Oleksandriia district, suggesting eastern launch sites for deep strikes (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68892, @mon1tor_ua/68913, @kpszsu/68268).
Guided RB UAV detected south of Nikopol heading toward Kryvyi Rih, Dnipropetrovsk region (Source: @eRadarrua/100721).
Jet UAV launched from Kursk region toward Kyrykivka, Sumy region (Source: @eRadarrua/100715).
Two jet UAVs detected on/past Polubotky, Chernihiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/100713).
RB UAV circling near Merefa, Kharkiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/100719).
UAV detected along northern Chernihiv region border with Belarus heading west/southwest (Source: @kpszsu/68255).
Reconnaissance activity reported over Chernihiv region; RB UAV at Sosnytsia and UAV at Dubovyazivka, Sumy region (Source: @eRadarrua/100792, @eRadarrua/100782).
Gerbera UAV on Mykolaivka and UAV on Esman, Sumy region (Source: @eRadarrua/100722).
Missile launched from Black Sea toward Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/68242).
UAV in Black Sea heading toward Chornomorsk/Nove Buhove (Source: @kpszsu/68265).
Two groups of strike UAVs over Black Sea; Russian tactical aviation boards over Crimea (Source: @eRadarrua/100782).
UAV on Mykolaiv from south; UAV on Vasylivka, Dnipropetrovsk region (Source: @eRadarrua/100782).
UAV on Lymanka, Odesa region and another over Black Sea (Source: @eRadarrua/100718).
Jet UAV in northern Zaporizhzhia region heading west (Source: @kpszsu/68268).
Russian tactical aviation launched guided bombs on Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @kpszsu/68266).

Massive Russian air operation detected: Su-30, Orion UAV over Black Sea; Su-34 over Crimea; Su-34, Su-57/34, Su-35 over Azov Sea preceding threatened missile strikes on Odesa ports (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68895).
First cruise missile confirmed inbound to Odesa; Su-34 over Azov Sea with Kh-59 missile threat toward Crimea (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68899, @mon1tor_ua/68894).

Multiple Shahed-type jet UAVs launched from Dnipropetrovsk toward Kirovohrad Oleksandriia district (2+ waves) and toward Cherkasy, Lubny Poltava region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68892, @mon1tor_ua/68913, @mon1tor_ua/68912, @mon1tor_ua/68910).
Russian tactical aviation active on northeastern front with guided bomb strikes on Synelnykove Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions (Source: @kpszsu/68263, @kpszsu/68266, @kpszsu/68257).
Ukrainian drone strike on Azov Sea port Rostov region with FP-1 drone days prior (Source: @eRadarrua/100724).
Russian air defenses destroyed 8 UAVs approaching Moscow (Source: @tass_agency/384943).
Two new groups of UAVs over Black Sea; reconnaissance UAVs over Chernihiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/100792).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is executing a coordinated deep-strike campaign combining missile threats on Odesa's critical port infrastructure with sustained guided bomb aviation strikes on Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia, while mass Shahed launches saturate central Ukrainian air defenses. The simultaneous deployment of Su-57/34, Su-35, Su-34, Su-30 and Orion UAV indicates a high-value targeting operation. Ukrainian retaliation on Rostov port and Moscow region signals expanding deep-strike exchange. Crimea's infrastructure collapse exacerbates Russian southern logistics vulnerabilities. The Patriot transfer and German FPV procurement will not materially affect near-term air defense gaps given 2028 missile delivery timeline.
sections.regional_response: Poland's emergency Patriot transfer under NATO/US pressure demonstrates alliance concern over Odesa missile threat, though replacement missiles are conditional. Germany's 50,000 Shrike FPV contract with autonomous targeting software represents a significant asymmetric capability boost for Ukraine's deep-strike campaign. NATO summit rhetoric shift acknowledged by Russian Foreign Ministry suggests diminished diplomatic off-ramps. Regional air defense coordination remains fragmented as evidenced by mass Shahed penetration to Cherkasy, Poltava, Kirovohrad. Black Sea port targeting risks further grain corridor disruption.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian use of Su-57/34 over Azov Sea in strike package suggests operational integration of advanced platforms for stand-off missile delivery. The FP-1 drone strike on Rostov port indicates Ukrainian naval drone evolution beyond FPV to fixed-wing strike assets. Crimea's seventh-day blackout reveals systemic Russian occupation infrastructure fragility. Russian drone operator success in Druzhkivka and Krasnohorivka shows improved tactical UAV-CUAS coordination. The 2028 Patriot missile timeline confirms Western production bottlenecks. Mass Shahed launches from Dnipropetrovsk suggest forward deployment of launch sites or Russian use of captured territory for deep strikes.
